The total is age 41–60 (1) + major surgery >45 minutes (2) + recent major surgery (1) + history of DVT/PE (3) + family history of thrombosis (3) + positive lupus anticoagulant (3) + bed confinement >72 hours (2) + COPD (1) + malignancy (2) + BMI >25 (1) = 19, not 22.
